name: Komodor
summary:
Komodor provides an AI SRE and Kubernetes operations platform that helps organisations troubleshoot, manage, and optimise cloud-native environments.

Together, we help organisations design, integrate, and operate Komodor across secure Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure platforms. From troubleshooting and incident response through to reliability, automation, and operational visibility, we help teams create resilient and operationally consistent Kubernetes environments.
overview:
Komodor helps platform, DevOps, and SRE teams manage Kubernetes environments through AI-assisted troubleshooting, reliability insights, change tracking, and operational automation.

Together, we help organisations build, integrate, and operate Komodor across cloud, hybrid, and enterprise Kubernetes infrastructure. From Kubernetes troubleshooting and incident management through to cost optimisation, automation, and platform governance, we help teams create environments that are reliable, observable, and operationally consistent.

Our focus is on building strong Kubernetes operational foundations that support long-term platform reliability. This includes observability, incident response, lifecycle management, automation, platform security, and operational enablement across complex cloud-native environments.

We help organisations reduce operational complexity, improve resilience, and operate Kubernetes platforms with confidence.
